title: Events & Retreats | Yoga Momente Coburg
description: Yoga retreat in the Rottal, fasting-season workshop and special occasions such as a girls' day or bachelorette party with Yoga Momente.

sections.title: Events & retreats
sections.lead: In our classes and at our events you discover how to build a positive connection with yourself and with others.

items.title: Yoga retreat in the Rottal
items.text: 13–15 November 2026 at the Neue Welt Haus. Yoga, meditation and mindfulness, maximum of 10 participants, €295 per person.

items.title: Fasting season with yoga.momente
items.text: We accompany you through 40 days of fasting season so you can follow through on your resolutions. With 3 online sessions, exchange in a WhatsApp group, information material, recipes and essential oils. From 5 people €140, from 10 people €90 per person.

sections.title: A girls' day or bachelorette party?
sections.text: Write to us and we will shape your yoga moment together.
